There's now a real "Online Profile" on the Map screen — create one to get a shareable Player Code, and the Arena leaderboard pulls real data once the backend (Vercel + Airtable) is deployed. Until then, everything falls back gracefully to local-only sample data — nothing breaks if the backend isn't live yet. Duel screen has real single-player combat against Squire/Knight/Master Wizard. Names, numbers, and remaining art are still placeholders; feel closely follows Master Duel as a reference point.
